title: Sticky Szechuan Prawn Bowl
subtitle: with fragrant rice and charred carrot
estimate_note: * Estimated: source gives these as sachets; sizes from HelloFresh UK recipes (aioli ≈ 32 g, soy sauce 25 ml, sriracha 7 g each).
steps: Preheat your oven to 220°C/200°C fan/gas mark 7.
Rinse the rice to remove excess starch. Add 600ml cold salted water (for 4P) to a medium pot with a tight-fitting lid.
Bring to the boil, add the rice, cover and lower the heat to medium. Cook for 10 mins, then remove from the heat and leave covered until ready to serve.
Trim the carrots, then halve lengthways and cut into batons.
Pop the carrots onto a lined baking tray, drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper.
Roast on the top shelf until charred, 15–18 mins.
Peel and grate the garlic. Trim and thinly slice the scallions.
In a small bowl, mix the soy sauce, sriracha, garlic and a splash of water.
Heat a drizzle of oil in a large frying pan on high heat.
Add the prawns and fry until pink and cooked through, 3–4 mins. Pour in the sauce and bubble until sticky, 1 min.
Fluff up the rice with a fork and share between your bowls.
Top with the carrots and sticky prawns. Drizzle over the aioli, scatter over the scallions and serve with a wedge of lime.
